TRACKRAT is a sprint club. We meet to run fast. Everything below exists so that stays fun and safe for everybody in the session.

EVERY SPEED BELONGS HERE.
The fastest athlete in the group and the person running their first 100m get the same respect. Support the people in your heat. The last rep gets cheered as loud as the first.
DON'T BE A JERK.
No harassment, no intimidation, no putting people down. That holds on the track, at the coffee after, at any TRACKRAT event, and in the group chat and the comments.
LOOK AFTER THE VOLUNTEERS.
Coaches, photographers and anyone else running a session are giving up their own training time to do it. Say thank you, and do what they ask while you are on the track.
KNOW WHERE THE LANE IS.
Check the track before you start a rep, and never cut across a live lane. Sprinting at full effort next to other people only works if everybody is paying attention.
LEAVE THE WHEELS AND THE HEADPHONES.
No bikes, skateboards, strollers or skates at sessions, and no headphones during reps. You need to hear the start, and you need to hear the people around you.
SAY SOMETHING IF SOMEONE IS STRUGGLING.
Heat, cramp, a pull, somebody off on their own looking rough. Tell a coach. Do not assume that somebody else already has it.

TRACKRAT may suspend or end anyone's participation for breaking this code.
